messages.raw: If you live for having it all, what you have is never enough.
messages.text: If you live for having it all, what you have is never enough.
messages.zh: 若你活着只为拥有一切,那你拥有多少都永远不够。

messages.context: Jacobus 新手流程实测台词（第 1 条）
messages.raw: Empty pockets never held anyone back. Only empty heads and empty hearts can do that.
messages.text: Empty pockets never held anyone back. Only empty heads and empty hearts can do that.
messages.zh: 空空的口袋从未阻挡过任何人,只有空洞的头脑和心灵才会。
